use_scope: Compatible category specimen for prototype measured prework with all residual limits declared. Raw seamless repeating cladding and any final building material application remain unapproved.
application_contract: Prototype category authority only; do not certify raw seamless repeating cladding.
Author board-aware geometry/UVs without raw horizontal tile wrapping, or make a bounded separate material correction before relying on tiled boundary continuity.

limits.symptom: Two inset groove bands separated by pale edge pixels at horizontal repetition; boundary groove is not equivalent to the seven internal joints.
limits.finite_correction: In a separately authorized bounded material correction, place complementary groove halves on the actual first/last pixel columns and reconcile adjacent edge colour. Alternatively use explicitly segmented board geometry/UVs that do not rely on raw horizontal tile wrapping. Verify the actual repeated surface at original resolution.

limits.symptom: Top/bottom grain phase unproven, strong repeated knots, golden hue and baked groove/highlight shading.
limits.finite_correction: Inspect actual board-aware application under final offline/browser lighting and source comparison before keeper claims; do not certify seamless albedo from this specimen.
